description: This Java class implements a function that encodes and transforms an array of strings into a single string suitable for MongoDB sort key mapping. It encodes special characters, replaces slashes with dots, and joins the elements with dots.

classes.name: MongoSortKeyMappingFunction
classes.description: A singleton class implementing a Function that maps an array of strings to a single encoded string for MongoDB sorting.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Transforms an array of strings by escaping special characters, replacing slashes with dots, and concatenating with dots.

methods.name: mapSortKey
methods.description: Public static method to apply the mapping function to given string arguments.
